Profile multi-field and cross-tab edits preserve siblings; save captures all notification/profile fields; cancel restores the last submission; example restore clears receipt

Booking edits preserve the confirmed receipt; cancellation clears receipt and keeps draft
Pricing controls edit one object and retain saved quote after later changes

observed: Name plus notification changes saved together without losing email/team

evidenceReuse.reason: Runtime source and dist hashes match U44. Existing core/Svelte/types/tarball tests remain applicable. The unchanged component catalog was verified in svelte-ui-kind-editor-verification-results.json; both changed example/editor suites rerun.

limitations: In-memory demo data and saved snapshots; no backend persistence, server-error handling or concurrent-user editing.
Field writes explicitly construct complete objects from closed required-field records. No nested-write or merge API added to core.
Customer IDs derive from row count in this append-only example.
Booking calendar remains fixed to November 2026.
